name: Yuria
source:
She is Kate's first officer and only shipmate abord their tiny stellar crusier. 

Yuria tries to cheer up her commanding officer when they're floating along in the dull, empty space between stars, but Kate doesn't appreciate the favor. 

When a space pirate vessel appears, that changes though, and soon both girls are blasting their way on board to loot the ship.

From "Angel Dust" story.
